mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a month signals tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a month indicates weakening labor market conditions, which can lead to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the correlation between UNRATE increases and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts over three months signals strong demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production by more than 1% in a month signals a contraction in supply, which can lead to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the correlation between INDPRO declines and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 4% and the CPI is increasing, the real interest rate is high, which signals a restrictive monetary policy and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: high inflation and restrictive monetary policy
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the interaction effect between high FEDFUNDS and increasing CPIAUCSL on negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls increase by more than 200,000 in a month and the unemployment rate decreases, it signals a strong labor market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the interaction effect between increasing PAYEMS and decreasing UNRATE on positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures over three months signals strong consumer demand, which is a leading indicator of economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production declines and the unemployment rate increases simultaneously, it signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the interaction effect between declining INDPRO and increasing UNRATE on negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
